m refers to static exception/one-year tables in some eligibility bodies but actual participations only in the scoped8-option body; no fabricated .code/.from_year input paths.
Normalized greening segment .end/.key fields are intermediate outputs, distinct from native .end_date/.segment_id.
farm.region is an actually read object container; its district/state leaves are separately counted and do not survive just because the container survives projection.
Policy namespace is data.o6_7; original static data namespace is data.oepul.o6_7. Both historical directories are loaded without remapping.
